title: Code Splitting
body:
Breaking the bundle into multiple chunks so the browser downloads only what the current view needs — ship Act 1 first, load Act 2 when the audience gets there. Usually triggered by a dynamic `import()` or a route-level lazy boundary.

The timing split is what makes this a good interview example: the *decision* about where to split is made at build time by the [[Module Bundler]], but the deferred chunk is actually fetched at **runtime, from the user's machine to their server**, at the moment the user navigates to that route. So one feature straddles both machines and both phases. The cost is a network round trip mid-interaction, which is why frameworks prefetch likely-next chunks on hover or idle.
